baseline_collection_adapter: Current collector feeds identical Markdown documents into archived original tokenization/scoring; original collector itself did not support .md.
sample_selection: Union of top 40 baseline candidates, top 40 final candidates, and 7 naturally occurring prose typos discovered during source review. Purposive review sample, not a random estimate of full-corpus precision.
capture_note: Initial capture reused real pyspellchecker corrections from a preliminary scan of the same corpus; new/uncached corrections used the actual library. Final after run is independently recomputed without that cache. No source edits or added typo seeds.
